dedupe_keys.name: enact edge cloud node and pod resource and power telemetry

description: This Zenodo release provides measured resource utilisation and power or energy telemetry from an ENACT edge-cloud computing setup in Thessaloniki, Greece. The article describes a Kubernetes deployment with one cloud machine and one edge device supporting a distributed weather-forecasting application. Its five pods represent two data sources, two forecasting services and long-term storage. Zenodo lists four CSV files separating node and pod telemetry when pods were on and off, under CC BY 4.0. These observations can test an edge-service energy or workload model, but the emulated application and two-node setup are not representative of a full data-centre region. Background services, hardware-specific measurements and the chosen weather workload are limitations for scaling power results. A reviewer-assessed use is checking energy costs of service placement between cloud and edge nodes. data-mawi-wide-backbone-traffic-archive is a related digital traffic trace, but its network packets are not equivalent to pod telemetry. No telemetry file or Kubernetes configuration was downloaded.
